body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Cambre presented its video gaming storage system 'GameOn' at CES 2010, which clean up gaming clutter, holds video game system and controllers and mounts easily to wall.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
